CustomField.description: Routing rule for AC_ReviewQuoteStepJourney. Scores are the Einstein Studio response models (probabilities 0-1, copied by the Data Cloud enrichments): Call_Score__c = probability the lead phones us, SMS_Score__c = probability the lead clicks a text, Email_Score__c = probability the lead opens the first email (logged, email always sent). Thresholds are placeholders until the first scoring run: call = the Call_Score__c value at the top 20%, text = the SMS_Score__c value at the top 50%. Replace the two numbers after each retrain.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Phone), 'Email Only', IF(Call_Score__c >= 0.20, IF(SMS_Score__c >= 0.50, 'Call + SMS + Email', 'Call + Email'), 'SMS + Email'))
CustomField.label: Predicted Channel
